api.web: VoiceSelector takes value, defaultValue, onValueChange, open, defaultOpen (false) and onOpenChange. VoiceSelectorContent takes title (default Voice Selector) and showCloseButton (default false). VoiceSelectorGender takes one of six values, VoiceSelectorAccent a named accent or any string, and VoiceSelectorPreview takes playing, loading and onPlay; useVoiceSelector returns value, setValue, open and setOpen.

interaction.web: Choosing a row calls its onSelect; the component does not set the value or close the dialog by itself, so the caller does both (setValue from the context, or its own state). The preview button stops propagation so a press does not also select the row, then calls onClick and onPlay. There is no corner close: Escape and a press outside close the dialog.
